create_offload_model: create an OffloadModel wrapping an nn.Sequential model to offload parameters to CPU during training
split_sequential_model: split an nn.Sequential model into balanced shards by parameter count using the _split function
create_model_shard: create a ModelShard wrapping a single model slice with forward_load and forward_drop methods
review_offload_function: review the OffloadFunction autograd class that enables activation checkpointing at shard boundaries
review_shard_sync_layer: review the ShardSyncLayer autograd class that synchronizes parameter loading between model shards
